svg.text: Fast-axis attenuation stress test: own-CAL selective error
Requested grid only; slow-axis population state R2=.94; T=193; CAL=2048, TEST=4096, REF=32768.
Observed error rate (log1p color scale; saturated at 50%)
s is a signal fraction, NOT MSE-based state R2. All cells use their own predicted REF variance and own-CAL median-gap threshold.
Shared physical/noise paths support paired descriptions. Cell values are estimates, not simultaneous certificates; no trained H-JEPA evaluation.
